Background is flat chroma colour (meta.bg) so games-src/scripts/cutout.py can key it: save each as <name>.png in one folder per character, then python3 games-src/scripts/cutout.py <folder>/<char>-*.png --out <target folder> --size 512 --align <meta.align>  (writes transparent webp + contact-sheet.png). Check the contact sheet: all poses the same height, same feet line. Style block: use the one in "style" but ignore any background wording in it.
